content.text:
Booking works again. The cause was in `createAppointment` in `src/repos/appointments.ts`: its INSERT still wrote to the old column `created_by`, which migration 004 renamed to `created_by_user_id`. It now uses the new name. I added a POST booking test, and typecheck plus all 19 tests pass.

In `src/lib/http.ts`, an unexpected failure in any `route()` handler now logs one error line and returns `{ "errorId": "err_<uuid>" }` with the 500. The line carries the error id, the method and path with no query string, and the cause (name, code, errno, sqlState, and a message with quoted values masked and cut to 300 characters). SQL, parameters and request bodies are never logged. The booking route puts nothing patient-related in its URL, so the Apache access log has none from it.
